ui.副本默认私有，不会复制分享链接。: Copies are private and do not inherit share links.

ui.可选择当前文件夹，或返回上级目录。: Choose this folder or return to a parent folder.

ui.此目录已公开，上传或添加的内容将对拥有分享链接的人可见。: This directory is published. Uploaded or added content will be visible to anyone with its share link.
